"""No-DB first temporary-write control under the unchanged resource proof."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from anvil import software_resource_proof as p
from anvil.golden_kyc_source import source_hash, _source_paths
from anvil.evaluator_configurations import _source_paths as adapter_paths
from anvil.policy_rules import Rule, evaluate_opa
assert source_hash()=='c26a7965e3ee215aa74e495c5341c15a2e0423f3952a1799111e8eef688201e4'
root=p.resources.qualification_root()
assert root==Path('/app')
names={str(path.relative_to(root)) for path in _source_paths(root)}
for adapter in ('builtin','zen','opa-local'):names.update(adapter_paths(adapter))
before=p._witness(root,names)
guard=None
try:
    with p.software_resources(object()):
        rule=Rule(kind='equals',field='supported',value=True)
        assert evaluate_opa(rule,{'supported':True},os.environ['ANVIL_OPA_BINARY'],expected_sha256=os.environ['ANVIL_OPA_SHA256'])['outcome']=='pass'
except RuntimeError as error:
    assert type(error) is RuntimeError and error.args==('Software resource closure changed before commit',)
    guard='software_resource_closure_changed'
after=p._witness(root,names)
fields=('device','inode','mode','uid','gid','nlink','size','mtime','ctime')
differences=[]
for path in sorted(set(before)|set(after)):
    if before.get(path)==after.get(path):continue
    assert path in before and path in after
    differences.append({'trusted_path':path,'metadata_fields':[field for index,field in enumerate(fields) if before[path][0][index]!=after[path][0][index]],'content_changed':before[path][1]!=after[path][1]})
assert guard is None and differences == [], 'Serving scratch write changed the protected resource closure'
print(json.dumps({'scope':'isolated_first_temp_write_under_original_proof','guard':guard,'differences':differences,'source_sha256':source_hash(),'database_operations':0,'model_calls':0,'qualification_granted':False},sort_keys=True))
